abstract: BACKGROUND: Previously, we have shown that increasing adult height is associated with increased risk of testicular germ-cell tumor (TGCT). Recently, a number of single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) have been found to be related to height. We examined whether these SNPs were associated with TGCT and whether they explained the relationship between height and TGCT. METHODS: We genotyped 15 height-related SNPs in the US Servicemen's Testicular Tumor Environmental and Endocrine Determinants (STEED) case-control study. DNA was extracted from buccal cell samples and Taqman assays were used to type the selected SNPs. We used logistic regression models to estimate odds ratios (ORs) and 95% confidence intervals (95%CIs). RESULTS: There were 561 cases and 676 controls for analysis. Two SNPs were found to be associated with risk of TGCT, rs6060373 (CC vs TT, OR = 1.51, 95% CI: 1.06-2.15) and rs143384 (CC vs TT, OR = 1.53, 95% CI: 1.09-2.15). rs6060373 is an intronic polymorphism of ubiquinol-cytochrome c reductase complex chaperone (UQCC), and rs143384 is a 5'UTR polymorphism of growth differentiation factor 5 (GDF5). No individual SNP attenuated the association between height and TGCT. Adjustment for all SNPs previously associated with adult height reduced the associations between adult height and TGCT by ~8.5%, although the P-value indicated only weak evidence that this difference was important (P = 0.26). CONCLUSIONS: This novel analysis provides tentative evidence that SNPs which are associated with adult height may also share an association with risk of TGCT.
abstract_ja:
背景：以前我々は、成人身長の増加が精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)のリスク上昇と関連することを示した。最近、身長に関連する多数の一塩基多型(SNP)が報告された。我々は、これらのSNPがTGCTと関連するか、またTGCTと身長の関連を説明するかを検討した。
方法：米国兵士の精巣腫瘍環境・内分泌決定因子(STEED)症例対照研究において、身長関連SNP 15か所を遺伝子型判定した。口腔粘膜細胞由来のDNAを抽出し、TaqmanアッセイでSNPを判定した。ロジスティック回帰モデルを用いてオッズ比(OR)と95%信頼区間(95%CI)を推定した。
結果：解析対象は症例561例、対照676例であった。TGCTリスクと関連したSNPは2つで、rs6060373(CC対TT、OR=1.51、95%CI: 1.06-2.15)とrs143384(CC対TT、OR=1.53、95%CI: 1.09-2.15)であった。rs6060373はユビキノール-シトクロムc還元酵素複合体シャペロン(UQCC)のイントロン多型、rs143384はgrowth differentiation factor 5(GDF5)の5'UTR多型である。個々のSNPは身長とTGCTの関連を減弱させなかった。身長に関連する既知のSNPすべてで調整すると、身長とTGCTの関連は約8.5%減少したが、その差に関するP値は弱いものであった(P = 0.26)。
結論：本研究の新規な解析は、身長に関連するSNPがTGCTリスクとも関連を有する可能性を示す暫定的な証拠を提供する。
